title: Invoice Chaser
one_line: Chase overdue invoices on a fixed escalation ladder that gets paid without damaging the relationship.
description: Chase overdue invoices on a fixed escalation ladder that gets paid without damaging the relationship. Use when invoices are overdue, when someone dreads chasing payment, or when they want a repeatable collections routine.
paragraph: Late payment is usually a process failure at the payer, not a refusal, and it is fixed by reaching the right person with the right document rather than by escalating tone. This skill sets a dated ladder, writes each message so it is easy to act on, and only shifts tone at the point where the ladder has run out.
keywords: how do i ask for payment
approval_stop: sending any reminder to a customer
